yaml:
id: agent-pretrade
version: 0.3.0
description: >
  Gate for trading agents: no APPROVE, no trade. 0.3.0, from a backtest of the
  106 answered Skein Sniper verdicts (eval/FINDINGS-sniper.md): any contract
  audit WARN (mintable, pausable, unreported tax) is a hard blocker, since 22
  of 23 such launches went to zero; and wash trading is required, so a launch
  with no trades yet abstains ("no market to judge exit risk") instead of an
  approval that rests on audit, liquidity and holders alone, which on fresh
  launches did not separate rugs from the rest. Thresholds unchanged.
blockers:
  - { check: sanctions, status: FAIL }
  - { check: contract_audit, status: FAIL, minSeverity: 2 }
  - { check: contract_audit, status: WARN }
  - { check: liquidity_depth, status: FAIL }
required: [contract_audit, sanctions, liquidity_depth, holder_count, wash_trading]
optional: []
thresholds:
  liquidity_depth: { warn: 250000, fail: 50000, field: liquidity_usd }
  holder_count: { warn: 500, fail: 100, field: holders_count }
  wash_trading: { warn: 20, fail: 50, field: wash_volume_pct }
weights: { contract_audit: 0.45, liquidity_depth: 0.30, wash_trading: 0.15, holder_count: 0.10 }
conflicts:
  - code: MARKET_INTEGRITY_CONFLICT
    detail: audit PASS but wash_trading FAIL
    when: [{ check: contract_audit, status: PASS }, { check: wash_trading, status: FAIL }]
decision:
  approve_below_risk_bps: 2000
  reject_above_risk_bps: 5000
  min_coverage: 0.85
  min_confidence: 0.65
  conflict_escalates: true
  abstain_on_missing_required: true
  required_fail_blocks_approve: true
  agreement_penalty: 0.25
scoring:
  status_risk: { PASS: 0, WARN: 0.5, FAIL: 1 }
  severity_multiplier: [0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.0]
budget: { max_usdc: 0.08, per_check_timeout_ms: { contract_audit: 8000, holder_count: 8000, default: 3000 } }
